title: SDLC Work Item Assessment v1
description: An agent-produced quality review of an intake work item. The assessment identifies strengths, ambiguity, contradictions, factual uncertainty, and questions that can improve the work item before or after user acceptance.
$comment: The root object is the assessment. Host validation must recompute assessmentScore.value, verify typed reference prefixes, ensure formula components match classification.workItemType, enforce question and reference uniqueness, and apply acceptance policy. Unanswered questions do not automatically prevent acceptance.

classification.description: Work-item classification used to select assessment factors and later decomposition policy.

confidence.description: Numeric confidence in the classification from 0 to 100.

rationale.description: Why the classification and confidence were selected.

assessmentScore.description: Numeric assessment components and a deterministic derived score. The host must recompute value and ignore any supplied value when calculating acceptance.

formulaVersion.description: Identifier of the deterministic score formula used for recomputation.

quality.description: Overall quality of the assessed work-item information; higher is better.

confidence.description: Confidence in the assessment itself; higher is better.

completeness.description: How much information needed for first-pass decomposition is present; higher is better.

clarity.description: How clearly the request, scope, and requirements are expressed; higher is better.

consistency.description: How well the request, scope, non-goals, requirements, and acceptance criteria agree; higher is better.

verifiability.description: How objectively the requirements and acceptance criteria can be verified; higher is better.

scopeBoundedness.description: How clearly the work is bounded and separable from adjacent work; higher is better.

ambiguity.description: Severity of unresolved interpretation ambiguity; higher is worse.

contradiction.description: Severity of contradictory statements or requirements; higher is worse.

factualUncertainty.description: Severity of unverified factual assumptions; higher is worse.

risk.description: Additional risk introduced by leaving uncertainty or quality gaps unresolved; higher is worse.

complexity.description: Intrinsic implementation complexity expected from the current work-item definition; higher is worse.

effort.description: Estimated implementation effort under the current definition; higher is worse.

typeFactors.description: Work-item-type-specific numeric factors. The host requires the object matching classification.workItemType.

outcomeClarity.description: Clarity of the desired product outcome; higher is better.

stakeholderClarity.description: Clarity of affected stakeholders and users; higher is better.

valueHypothesisStrength.description: Strength of the stated value hypothesis; higher is better.

domainUncertainty.description: Uncertainty in domain rules or vocabulary; higher is worse.

decisionReadiness.description: Readiness for a product-level planning decision; higher is better.

behaviorClarity.description: Clarity of the observable behavior; higher is better.

compatibilityCoverage.description: Coverage of compatibility and integration constraints; higher is better.

integrationUncertainty.description: Uncertainty in affected integration boundaries; higher is worse.

acceptanceReadiness.description: Readiness of acceptance criteria for decomposition and validation; higher is better.

reproductionQuality.description: Quality of the bounded failure reproduction; higher is better.

expectedActualClarity.description: Clarity of expected versus actual behavior; higher is better.

rootCauseConfidence.description: Confidence in the root-cause hypothesis; higher is better.

regressionReadiness.description: Readiness of regression evidence and acceptance checks; higher is better.

typeFactorValue.description: Normalized 0–100 contribution of the selected work-item-type factors; host-computed.

value.description: Final normalized 0–100 assessment score; host-computed and ignored as input when recomputing.

calculation.description: Auditable metadata for the deterministic assessment score calculation.

commonValue.description: Normalized common-factor score before type-specific weighting; host-computed.

equation.description: Human-readable deterministic equation used to recompute value.

valueSource.description: Indicates that value is derived by the host rather than trusted from the input.
